title: Jucy Weeknight Ethiopian Morcilla Tagine
description: A floral, crunchy weeknight dish featuring morcilla, perfect for a flexitarian-friendly meal. Serve with crusty bread or injera for a delicious and satisfying dinner.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Use kosher salt for best flavor

ingredients.name: Black pepper
ingredients.notes: Use fresh peppercorns for best flavor

instructions: Heat oil in a clay tajine over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onions and cook, stirring occasionally, until they are lightly browned and caramelized, about 20 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add the morcilla and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until it is lightly browned and crumbly, about 5 minutes.
Add the berbere spice, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper, and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add the sliced leeks and cook, stirring occasionally, until they are tender and lightly browned, about 10 minutes.
Stir in the chopped parsley and cilantro, and serve hot over crusty bread or injera.
Garnish with additional parsley and cilantro, if desired.
Serve with a side of steamed vegetables or a simple green salad, if desired.
